title: Better Rankers, Worse Retrievers: The Hidden Cost of RL Post-Training in Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22838v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative recommenders decode the semantic ID of a user's next item with a language model, and post-training them with reinforcement learning (RL) after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) has become standard practice. The gains are mostly reported on the first ten results, yet in deployment such models hand hundreds of candidates to a downstream ranker or reward model. We show that RL post-training has a hidden cost: it improves accuracy at the top of the list (hit@K for small K) but, on all five datasets we study, lowers the recall of the candidate list (hit@K for K in the hundreds). The model becomes a better ranker and a worse retriever. Controlled experiments trace the loss to the negative advantages that RL assigns to the candidates it samples, the rollout. The root cause is that only one next item is logged per user, so RL treats every other candidate as wrong. Yet these candidates are the model's most plausible alternatives, and ofte

translated_title: 更好的排序器，更差的检索器：生成式推荐中强化学习后训练的隐性代价
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐器通过语言模型解码用户下一个物品的语义ID，在监督微调（SFT）之后使用强化学习（RL）进行后训练已成为标准做法。相关增益大多是在前十项结果上报告的，然而在实际部署中，此类模型需要将数百个候选结果交给下游的排序器或奖励模型。我们揭示了强化学习后训练的一个隐性代价：它提升了列表顶部的准确率（小K值下的hit@K），但在我们研究的全部五个数据集上，都降低了候选列表的召回率（数百K值下的hit@K）。模型变成了更好的排序器，却成了更差的检索器。受控实验将这一性能损失追溯到强化学习为其采样候选（rollout）所分配的负优势。根本原因在于每个用户只记录了一个真实的下一个物品，因此强化学习将所有其他候选都视为错误。然而这些候选恰恰是模型最合理的替代选择，而且往往……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了强化学习后训练在生成式推荐中的隐性代价：由于每个用户只有一个真实标签，RL将模型采样的合理替代候选一律视为错误并给予负优势，导致模型在提升列表顶部排序准确率的同时显著降低了候选列表的召回率，成为更好的排序器却是更差的检索器。
en_tdlr: RL post-training improves top-of-list ranking accuracy in generative recommenders but reduces candidate-list recall, because with only one logged ground-truth item per user, RL treats the model's most plausible alternative candidates as wrong—making the model a better ranker but a worse retriever.
